proc_onboarding.name: Employee Onboarding
proc_onboarding.riskRefs: Late IT provisioning, Missed compliance training

guardrail.allow: Send onboarding checklist reminders, auto-schedule orientation calendar invites
guardrail.deny: Approve compensation changes, modify offer terms
guardrail.escalateIf: New-hire start date changes within 5 business days

proc_complaint.name: Customer Complaint Resolution
proc_complaint.kpiRefs: Mean time to resolution, First-contact resolution rate
proc_complaint.riskRefs: Regulatory complaint mishandling, Repeat unresolved complaints

guardrail.allow: Log complaint, send acknowledgement, issue goodwill credit under $50
guardrail.deny: Issue refunds above policy limit, make legal admissions
guardrail.escalateIf: Severity is High, or customer requests a manager

obl_iso9001_4_1.title: Understanding the organization and its context
obl_iso9001_4_1.summary: Know the internal and external issues that shape what the quality system must achieve, and keep that view current.

obl_iso9001_4_2.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
obl_iso9001_4_2.summary: Identify who has a stake in quality and which of their requirements matter, and review them over time.

obl_iso9001_4_3.title: Determining the scope of the quality management system
obl_iso9001_4_3.summary: State clearly which sites, products and services the quality system covers, and justify anything left out.

obl_iso9001_4_4.title: Quality management system and its processes
obl_iso9001_4_4.summary: Define each process with an owner, inputs, outputs, sequence, resources, risks and measures, and keep them working together.

obl_iso9001_5_1.title: Leadership and commitment
obl_iso9001_5_1.summary: Top management is visibly accountable for the quality system and for keeping customers at the centre.

obl_iso9001_5_2.title: Policy
obl_iso9001_5_2.summary: Maintain a quality policy that fits the organization's purpose, is communicated and is understood.

obl_iso9001_5_3.title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
obl_iso9001_5_3.summary: Assign and communicate who is responsible and has authority for each part of the quality system.

obl_iso9001_6_1.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
obl_iso9001_6_1.summary: Plan how risks and opportunities affecting quality will be handled, and check the actions work.

obl_iso9001_6_2.title: Quality objectives and planning to achieve them
obl_iso9001_6_2.summary: Set measurable quality objectives and plan who does what, by when, to reach them.

obl_iso9001_6_3.title: Planning of changes
obl_iso9001_6_3.summary: Change the quality system in a planned way, considering consequences, resources and responsibilities.

obl_iso9001_7_1.title: Resources
obl_iso9001_7_1.summary: Provide the people, infrastructure, environment, measuring resources and knowledge the processes need.

obl_iso9001_7_2.title: Competence
obl_iso9001_7_2.summary: Make sure people doing work that affects quality are competent, and keep evidence of it.

obl_iso9001_7_3.title: Awareness
obl_iso9001_7_3.summary: People know the policy, relevant objectives, their contribution and the consequences of not conforming.

obl_iso9001_7_4.title: Communication
obl_iso9001_7_4.summary: Decide what is communicated about the quality system, to whom, when and how.

obl_iso9001_7_5.title: Documented information
obl_iso9001_7_5.summary: Create, approve, version, distribute, protect and retain the documents and records the system needs.

obl_iso9001_8_1.title: Operational planning and control
obl_iso9001_8_1.summary: Plan and control the processes that deliver products and services, with criteria and records.

obl_iso9001_8_2.title: Requirements for products and services
obl_iso9001_8_2.summary: Determine, review and communicate customer and other requirements before committing to deliver.

obl_iso9001_8_3.title: Design and development of products and services
obl_iso9001_8_3.summary: Run design work through planned stages with inputs, controls, outputs and managed changes.

obl_iso9001_8_4.title: Control of externally provided processes, products and services
obl_iso9001_8_4.summary: Select, evaluate and control suppliers and outsourced work that affect quality.

obl_iso9001_8_5.title: Production and service provision
obl_iso9001_8_5.summary: Deliver under controlled conditions, with traceability, care of property, preservation and post-delivery activities.

obl_iso9001_8_6.title: Release of products and services
obl_iso9001_8_6.summary: Verify requirements are met before release, and record who authorized it.

obl_iso9001_8_7.title: Control of nonconforming outputs
obl_iso9001_8_7.summary: Identify and control outputs that do not conform so they are not used or delivered unintentionally.

obl_iso9001_9_1.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
obl_iso9001_9_1.summary: Decide what to measure, including customer satisfaction, and analyse results to judge performance.

obl_iso9001_9_2.title: Internal audit
obl_iso9001_9_2.summary: Audit the quality system at planned intervals against criteria, and act on findings.

obl_iso9001_9_3.title: Management review
obl_iso9001_9_3.summary: Top management reviews the system at planned intervals with defined inputs and records decisions.

obl_iso9001_10_1.title: Improvement — general
obl_iso9001_10_1.summary: Pick and act on opportunities to improve products, services and the quality system.

obl_iso9001_10_2.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
obl_iso9001_10_2.summary: React to nonconformities, find root causes, correct them and confirm the fix worked.

obl_iso9001_10_3.title: Continual improvement
obl_iso9001_10_3.summary: Keep improving how suitable, adequate and effective the quality system is.

obl_iso9004_4_1.title: Quality of an organization
obl_iso9004_4_1.summary: Judge quality by how well the organization meets the needs of its interested parties over time.

obl_iso9004_4_2.title: Managing for sustained success
obl_iso9004_4_2.summary: Balance short- and long-term needs to keep the organization successful.

obl_iso9004_5_1.title: Context — general
obl_iso9004_5_1.summary: Understand context as the basis for strategy and sustained success.

obl_iso9004_5_2.title: Relevant interested parties
obl_iso9004_5_2.summary: Identify the parties that matter, what they need, and how the relationship benefits both sides.

obl_iso9004_5_3.title: External and internal issues
obl_iso9004_5_3.summary: Track the issues inside and outside the organization that can help or hinder its goals.

obl_iso9004_6_1.title: Identity — general
obl_iso9004_6_1.summary: Define what the organization is and stands for as the anchor for decisions.

obl_iso9004_6_2.title: Mission, vision, values and culture
obl_iso9004_6_2.summary: Keep mission, vision, values and culture explicit, shared and consistent with behaviour.

obl_iso9004_7_1.title: Leadership — general
obl_iso9004_7_1.summary: Leaders create unity of purpose and the conditions for people to engage.

obl_iso9004_7_2.title: Policy and strategy
obl_iso9004_7_2.summary: Turn identity into a policy and strategy that are deployed and reviewed.

obl_iso9004_7_3.title: Objectives
obl_iso9004_7_3.summary: Set objectives at each level that follow from the strategy and can be measured.

obl_iso9004_7_4.title: Communication
obl_iso9004_7_4.summary: Communicate strategy and objectives so people understand their part.

obl_iso9004_8_1.title: Process management — general
obl_iso9004_8_1.summary: Manage activities as interrelated processes to get consistent, predictable results.

obl_iso9004_8_2.title: Determination of processes
obl_iso9004_8_2.summary: Determine the processes needed, how they interact and what they must deliver.

obl_iso9004_8_3.title: Responsibility and authority relating to processes
obl_iso9004_8_3.summary: Give each process an accountable owner with the authority to manage it.

obl_iso9004_8_4.title: Managing processes
obl_iso9004_8_4.summary: Plan, run, measure and improve processes, managing their interactions and risks.

obl_iso9004_9_1.title: Resource management — general
obl_iso9004_9_1.summary: Plan and provide the resources needed for sustained success.

obl_iso9004_9_2.title: People
obl_iso9004_9_2.summary: Engage, develop and empower people, and recognise their contribution.

obl_iso9004_9_3.title: Organizational knowledge
obl_iso9004_9_3.summary: Capture, share and protect the knowledge the organization depends on.

obl_iso9004_9_4.title: Technology
obl_iso9004_9_4.summary: Evaluate and adopt technology that improves performance.

obl_iso9004_9_5.title: Infrastructure and work environment
obl_iso9004_9_5.summary: Provide and maintain infrastructure and a work environment that support the work.

obl_iso9004_9_6.title: Externally provided resources
obl_iso9004_9_6.summary: Manage suppliers and partners as part of the value chain.

obl_iso9004_9_7.title: Natural resources
obl_iso9004_9_7.summary: Use natural resources responsibly and with an eye on future availability.

obl_iso9004_10_1.title: Performance analysis — general
obl_iso9004_10_1.summary: Monitor, measure, analyse and evaluate performance to inform decisions.

obl_iso9004_10_2.title: Performance indicators
obl_iso9004_10_2.summary: Choose indicators that show progress against objectives and strategy.

obl_iso9004_10_3.title: Performance analysis
obl_iso9004_10_3.summary: Analyse indicator data to find trends, causes and opportunities.

obl_iso9004_10_4.title: Performance evaluation
obl_iso9004_10_4.summary: Evaluate results against objectives and benchmarks to judge progress.

obl_iso9004_10_5.title: Internal audit
obl_iso9004_10_5.summary: Use internal audits to check effectiveness and find improvement opportunities.

obl_iso9004_10_6.title: Self-assessment
obl_iso9004_10_6.summary: Assess maturity regularly against the five-level scale to set improvement priorities.

obl_iso9004_10_7.title: Reviews
obl_iso9004_10_7.summary: Review performance and context at planned intervals and decide what to change.

obl_iso9004_11_1.title: Improvement, learning and innovation — general
obl_iso9004_11_1.summary: Treat improvement, learning and innovation as interdependent drivers of success.

obl_iso9004_11_2.title: Improvement
obl_iso9004_11_2.summary: Improve processes, products and the organization in a structured way.

obl_iso9004_11_3.title: Learning
obl_iso9004_11_3.summary: Learn from successes, failures and others, and turn it into practice.

obl_iso9004_11_4.title: Innovation
obl_iso9004_11_4.summary: Encourage and manage innovation in products, processes and the organization.
